name: dev.minitok/minitok
title: minitok
description: Verified coding workflows with planning, verification, bounded retries, evidence, and evolution.

environmentVariables.name: MINITOK_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Owner-only runtime token file created by minitok mcp connect; required for authenticated local MCP sessions.

environmentVariables.name: MINITOK_MCP_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Explicit local scopes. Defaults to read; add write and verify_exec only when the user intends repository changes and verification execution.

environmentVariables.name: MINITOK_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTPS minitok service URL override. Defaults to https://api.minitok.dev.
